edit.description: worktree presence/absence verdicts read readWorktreeRegistry instead of substring-matching a hand-spawned `worktree list`

summary: tests/Dispatcher.test.ts spawns `worktree list --porcelain` at seven sites and substring-matches host-separator paths against it; three absence verdicts are unconditionally green on the windows lane

per.section: A green verdict is proven non-vacuous

acceptance: no `worktree list` spawn is left in the file; presence and absence are exact membership over readWorktreeRegistry's resolved paths, and its read:false arm refuses rather than reading as an empty set
pins: a tick's teardown leaves the repo's worktree registry holding only the primary checkout
a fanout wave's teardown leaves the repo's worktree registry holding only the primary checkout
the startup sweep leaves the orphan's path out of the repo's worktree registry
notes: Sites ~438/3251/3296/3350/3391/3414/3484, beside readWorktreeRegistry the file already imports (line 41, used once at 16874). Lines 443/3298/3353 assert `not.toContain(join('.flume','worktrees',...))`; git prints forward slashes on every platform (the file says so at 3255), so on windows-latest — a lane .github/workflows/ci.yml:12 really runs — the needle is a string git never emits and the verdict is green over nothing. The positive ones pin a path fragment, not a registered path.
